package.description: Tired of interruptions? Luniq is a sleek, open-source music player built for a seamless listening experience.

en-US.description: Tired of interruptions? Luniq is a sleek, open-source music player built for a seamless listening experience.
en-US.longDescription: Luniq is an open-source desktop music player made by Saraans. It's not trying to be everything just the one app you actually want to open when you want to listen to music. We made it because most players feel like they were designed for everyone except you. No fuss, no clutter. Just your music, the way it should be :3
en-US.name: Luniq
